title: tc-capacity-bars
description:
People's capacity: each person's allocation, split by what they work on, against what they can take, with anyone
over capacity marked and counted.

heading.description: The heading, and the grid's name

unit.description: The unit loads are counted in: "FTE", "h", "%"

sort.description: "load" puts the most loaded first; "none" keeps the order given

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

selected.description: The selected person's id. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

picture.description: A picture URL; without one the row shows the name's initials

capacity.description: How much they can take, in `unit` – 1 FTE by default

id.description: Identifies the piece of work; the same id gets the same colour on every row

label.description: What it is, e.g. "Climate Resilience Modeling"

amount.description: How much of the person it takes, in `unit`
